title: Triton & Sea Haven
meta_description: Two condos, one building: Triton \& Sea Haven sleep 15 with pool \& hot tub access, private balconies \& the beach a 3-minute walk away.
description_expanded:
On the quiet east end of Seagrove Beach, two condos in the same building give your group the best of both worlds: everyone under one roof, everyone with their own space. Together, Triton \& Sea Haven offer four bedrooms and room for 15 --- and the Gulf is a three-minute walk down the street, with Walton Dunes Beach Access delivering you straight onto the sugar-white sand. When you're ready to explore, Seaside's shops and food trucks are about ten minutes west, and Alys Beach's striking white architecture and dining scene are ten minutes east along Scenic Highway 30A.

Triton greets you with a bright, airy interior. The living room opens to a dining area with seating for six, and the fully equipped kitchen has modern appliances and plenty of counter space for group meal prep. The primary bedroom holds a king bed, its own TV, and an ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom pairs a queen bed with a twin-over-twin bunk --- a flexible setup for kids, cousins, or friends. The private balcony overlooks the community pool and hot tub below, and makes a fine spot for a meal in the ocean breeze.

Sea Haven leans elegant with a touch of rustic charm, natural light filling the space and playing off the stylish decor. A fully equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry, and built-in WiFi speakers keep daily life easy. The primary bedroom features a king bed and private ensuite bathroom; the second bedroom holds a twin-over-queen bunk, and two sleeper sofas in the living room --- one queen, one full --- round out the sleeping arrangements. The balcony here works from morning till night: barstool seating along the counter for coffee with a breeze, then tall Adirondack chairs and string lights as the sky turns to sunset color.

Between beach sessions, the community amenities carry the day. You'll have access to the pool and hot tub, lounge chairs for tanning, and a spacious shaded cabana with plenty of seating, plus grills and picnic tables nearby for an easy cookout night. And when the pool's had its turn, the waves are waiting just down the street.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The communal pool is not heated.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- Each unit has onsite parking for 2 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
